dataset: ACS 2022 5-year block-group vulnerability counts (observed, Census Bureau)
licence: US Census Bureau data are US government works (public domain, Title 17 USC 105); cite 'U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates'.

tables.B18101: Sex by age by disability status (civilian noninstitutionalized population)
tables.C16002: Household language by household limited English speaking status (households)

universe_notes.disab_universe: civilian noninstitutionalized population with disability status determined (B18101)
universe_notes.disab_*: TRACT-level counts repeated on every block group of the tract (B18101 is not published for block groups); use only the shares (disability, disability_65plus), never sum these counts across block groups

moe90: 90% margin of error of the sum (root sum of squares of cell margins); block-group estimates are noisy
coordinate_note: lat/lon are the TIGER/Line internal point of the block group, not a centroid of residents
